mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent recessionary indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with accommodative policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST YoY decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS and UNRATE changes does not correlate with a strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent consumer demand strength.
